title: Rejection Gap Lower Bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube that is not a dictator. The minimum rejection probability of the uniform mixture of the odd BLR equation test and the sign-AND test, taken over all non-dictator sign-valued functions on that cube, is at most the rejection probability of this test on $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
